metadata.method: Native adaptive Dopri8, I controller, standard dense output; accepted-only checkpointed AD
metadata.parameters: All 136 bundled QA coil Fourier/normalized-current DOFs; fixed births and reference axis
metadata.births: x=linspace(1.23,1.27) m; y=z=0; pitch=linspace(.35,.65); 4 keV alphas; Lorentz gyrophase pi
metadata.gc_state: Production collisionless energy-based (x,y,z,v_parallel); split-collision GC uses evolving mu instead
metadata.scope: Blocked warm CPU calls, no collisions, no Diffrax, no particle chunking; compilation separate
metadata.phase_policy: Reverse reuses a baseline pullback; linearization uses public jax.vjp. Independent phases need not sum to fused value_and_grad.
metadata.kernel_policy: Independent local kernels at birth states; full RHS VJP repeats coil setup, prepared VJP exposes all prepared cotangents. Not an additive breakdown of the whole backward pass.
metadata.state_only_policy: Diagnostic reverse with identical fields, initial states, accepted schedules and objective; differentiate initial states only, holding coils fixed. This is not the coil-optimization gradient.
metadata.work_count_policy: Nominal algorithmic counts per particle. Vmapped masked lanes and compiler dead-code elimination can change physical kernel execution.
metadata.memory_scope: Compiler buffers only, not process peak RSS
